extName.description: Extension name (brand, never translated). Max 75 characters.

extDescription.message: Skip sponsor reads inside YouTube videos. Reads the captions, marks the sponsor segment, and jumps past it, with one-click Undo.
extDescription.description: Chrome Web Store summary and manifest description. Max 132 characters.

actionTitle.description: Toolbar button tooltip while skipping is on (brand only).

actionTitleOff.description: Toolbar button tooltip while skipping is off.

localeCode.description: BCP 47 code of this catalog's language; set as <html lang> on extension pages.

privacyPolicyUrl.description: Privacy policy page in this language.

termsUrl.description: Terms of use page in this language.

modeAutoShort.description: Auto-skip mode on the popup's compact mode button (max ~12 characters).

modeHelpAuto.message: Auto-skip — cuts marked ranges as they start

modeHelpNotify.message: Notify — marks the range and shows a Skip button

percentValueText.description: Screen-reader value of the threshold slider.

popupDetectedSegments.description: Accessible name of the segment list.

popupNotRunning.message: SkipSponsor AI isn’t running in this tab yet.

popupOpenVideo.message: Open a YouTube video to see its sponsor reads here.

popupAnalyzeFailed.message: Couldn’t analyze this video — it plays normally.

popupNotAnalyzed.message: Couldn’t analyze this video — there are no captions to read, so it plays normally.

popupNothingToSkip.message: No captions, and no community-labelled sponsors — nothing to skip.

popupNoSponsorReads.message: No sponsor reads found in this video.

popupChannelSkippingOff.description: Channel line when the channel is in the don't-skip list.

popupRowLabel.description: Screen-reader label of one segment row.

tagCut.description: Short tag (max ~6 letters): the segment is skipped automatically.

tagAsk.description: Short tag (max ~6 letters): a Skip button is offered.

tagKeep.description: Short tag (max ~6 letters): the segment plays.

tagLimit.description: Short tag on the limit notice.

statusSkipButtonAt.description: TIME is a position in the video, not a clock time.

thresholdNone.message: Dots show this video’s detected segments — none so far.

thresholdCut.message: Dots are this video’s detected segments. Anything right of the line gets cut — $OVER$ of $TOTAL$ here.

thresholdAsk.message: Dots are this video’s detected segments. Anything right of the line gets a Skip button — $OVER$ of $TOTAL$ here.

thresholdWould.message: Dots are this video’s detected segments. Anything right of the line would be cut — $OVER$ of $TOTAL$ here.

limitInstallQuotaSub.message: Analyzed videos still skip · more at $AT$
limitInstallQuotaSub.description: Max 48 characters with AT filled in (a local clock time).

limitInstallQuotaPopup.message: You’ve used today’s free AI analyses. Videos already analyzed still skip. More analyses at $AT$.

limitGlobalBudgetSub.description: Max 48 characters with AT filled in (a local clock time).

limitGlobalBudgetPopup.message: SkipSponsor AI reached today’s free analysis capacity. Videos already analyzed still skip. New analyses resume at $AT$.

limitLlmNotConfiguredPopup.message: The SkipSponsor AI server isn’t set up for AI analysis yet. Videos already analyzed still skip.

limitLlmDisabledPopup.message: AI analysis is paused for now. Videos already analyzed still skip.

limitSettingUpSub.message: Plays normally · retries on your next video

limitSettingUpPopup.message: SkipSponsor AI is still finishing setup in this browser and tries again on your next video. Videos already analyzed still skip.

limitUnreachablePopup.message: SkipSponsor AI couldn’t connect to its server for this video, so it plays normally. Videos already analyzed still skip.

toastDismiss.description: Accessible name of the toast's close button.

optionsDocTitle.description: Settings tab title: brand, then the section name.

generalDesc.message: Changes save automatically and apply to the video that’s playing.

generalEnableHint.message: Turn SkipSponsor AI on or off everywhere.

modeNotifyDesc.message: Shows a Skip button — you decide.

optionsThresholdHint.message: Skip only when the AI is at least $PCT$% sure the segment is a sponsor read.

channelsDesc.message: Skipping is turned off on these channels — support creators whose reads you want to hear.

optionsChannelHint.message: Paste a channel link, or type its @handle.

optionsInvalidChannel.message: That doesn’t look like a YouTube channel. Try @creator or a link like youtube.com/@creator.

optionsChannelAdded.message: Added $CHANNEL$. Its sponsor reads will play normally.

channelsEmptyHint.message: Add one above, or use “Don’t skip this channel” in the popup while watching.

optionsRemoveLabel.message: Remove $NAME$ — skip sponsor reads on this channel again

privacyDesc.message: Plain-language summary of what SkipSponsor AI reads and keeps.

privacyCaptionsTitle.message: Only caption text is analyzed, never audio

privacyCaptionsHint.message: The video’s captions are read to find where a sponsor read begins and ends.

privacyAccountHint.message: Works without sign-in. An anonymous install token protects the service from abuse.

privacyCacheTitle.message: Results are cached for 30 days, then deleted

privacyCacheHint.message: Segment results are shared per video so repeat views are instant.

privacyNoCaptionsHint.message: SkipSponsor AI reads only the video’s own captions. When a video has none, it says so and the video plays normally.

privacyShareUsageHint.message: Sends “skipped” and “undone” events (video ID and timing) so accuracy can be measured, and an anonymous count of installs, uninstalls and days used (a random ID and the extension version; no video or page). Skipping works the same either way.

privacyResetHint.message: Clears your settings, channel list and anonymous install ID in this browser.

privacyWhoResponsible.message: Who is responsible for your data

privacyController.message: $LEGAL$ ($BRAND$) provides SkipSponsor AI and is responsible for the data it sends. Questions or requests:
privacyController.description: Followed by the contact email as a link; keep the trailing space.

privacyFullPolicyHint.message: What is processed, where it goes, and how long it is kept.

aboutDesc.message: SkipSponsor AI skips sponsor segments inside videos. It doesn’t block YouTube’s own ads.

optionsCantReach.message: Can’t reach $HOST$. Videos will play normally until it’s back.

aboutReportSkip.message: Report a wrong or missed skip
